notes.title: Isolation fix and update here!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

The Isolation fix and update is finally here! The game can now be completed, as well as the addition of a new area! This new area introduces outdoor gameplay. The enemy AI has also been re-located so it doesn't glitch.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Huge update has arrived!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

The largest update for Isolation has finally arrived! It includes many new features. Check the changelist below for further details:

Changelist:    

-Enemy AI
-Hiding system
-Security camera system
-New scare
-The normal camera should now work in all levels
-New pause menu
-FPS counter removed for better immersion
-Other things

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Isolation Fix 2!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

The next fix for Isolation is here! Below is the changelist.

Changelist:    

-Fixed wall issue, now you cannot go through it.

-All capsules now have colliders, in the last fix, only the last level capsules had colliders.

-Office chair now is smaller and also has a collider.

-The pause menu was also changed. The main menu button was removed as it wasn't working. Hopefully I can get a new pause menu which will have a better variety of options.

I am also doing a key giveaway on my main group for Isolation. Check the announcement out on the group to see how to enter the giveaway if you are interested.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Isolation Fix!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

There were some issues with the first version of Isolation. Here is the list of fixes:

Changelist:    

-Bathroom on level 1 now has colliders

-Level 2 bathroom floor now has a collider so you cannot fall through

Thank you for the feedback! The next fix will include persistent cameras and the capsules will have colliders!

Interactive Gaming Studios
